description.value: The Carnegie Community Centre occupies Vancouver's original Carnegie Library building, a landmark heritage structure at the corner of Main and Hastings in the Downtown Eastside. Operated by the City of Vancouver, it functions as a major community hub offering programs, services, and gathering space for one of the city's most storied neighbourhoods. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find it a recognizable and historically significant stop.
